verdict.rationale: Incident management is a fair question for an observability platform, so the axis applies. The pack only documents alerting, where you define thresholds and route notifications to a team. That is an adjacent capability, not incident declaration, incident timelines, on-call schedules, or escalation policies, and nothing in the pack evidences those.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can declare and track incidents with timelines, on-call schedules, and escalation policies
